title: Comcast’s Network Powers Gaming’s Biggest Moments with Fastly, Delivering Faster Downloads and Less Lag
summary: Comcast and Fastly’s New Delivery Model Can Reduce Network Round-Trip Time by More Than 40 Percent, Improving Content Delivery Speed and Efficiency
body_markdown:
*Comcast’s Multi-Year Investment in Its Distributed Network, Low-Latency Technology and Advanced WiFi is Transforming the Gaming Experience*


*Comcast and Fastly’s New Delivery Model Can Reduce Network Round-Trip Time by More Than 40 Percent, Improving Content Delivery Speed and Efficiency*


**PHILADELPHIA and SAN FRANCISCO – November 18, 2026 –** The future of gaming is placing unprecedented demands on the Internet, from millions of players downloading massive games simultaneously to increasingly immersive experiences that depend on split-second responsiveness. Comcast has spent years preparing for this future, transforming its nationwide network with distributed computing, intelligent software, low-latency technology and advanced in-home WiFi. Now, as the industry prepares for major game launches, Comcast and Fastly are working together to leverage that infrastructure to deliver popular game files closer to players. The companies’ new delivery model can reduce network round-trip time by more than 40 percent, improving download performance and overall network efficiency.


*Grand Theft Auto VI* will launch Thursday, November 19, 2026, creating the potential for extraordinary Internet activity as millions of people download games while streaming, working and browsing at the same time. Already, preloads have generated some of the busiest days in Comcast’s network history, including the largest single-day gaming event the company has ever recorded. Comcast’s network and Fastly’s platform are both designed for these moments, handling exceptional demand while helping gamers spend less time waiting and more time playing.


“ *Grand Theft Auto VI* could be one of the biggest moments in Internet history,” said Elad Nafshi, Chief Network Officer, Comcast. “We’ve spent years transforming our network to prepare for moments like these, building the scale and intelligence needed to handle extraordinary demand while delivering better experiences for customers. Our work with Fastly is another example of how we’re putting those investments to work, and we’re just beginning to unlock what’s possible for the next generation of gaming.”


### **Built for Gaming’s Biggest Moments**


Comcast’s nationwide broadband[network](https://corporate.comcast.com/our-network) reaches approximately 65 million homes and businesses, supported by hundreds of thousands of miles of fiber, distributed computing infrastructure and intelligent software. That combination of scale and intelligence allows Comcast to manage extraordinary demand while bringing content and network capabilities closer to customers. **** These capabilities are especially important during blockbuster game launches, when millions of players download the same files within a short period.


Traditionally, popular game files may travel long distances across the Internet before reaching players. Comcast and Fastly’s content delivery model allows participating game publishers and distribution partners to deliver content directly from within Comcast’s distributed network infrastructure, reducing unnecessary traffic and improving performance.


“We’ve delivered a faster, more seamless experience for users by integrating Fastly’s programmable edge platform directly into Comcast’s distributed network. This level of performance and capacity is critical for gaming, especially for historic launches like *Grand Theft Auto VI* ,” said Kip Compton, Chief Executive Officer at Fastly. “Bringing large game files closer to players helps deliver major releases more efficiently and sets a new standard for handling peak demand without sacrificing speed, security or reliability.”


The technology builds on Comcast and Fastly’s[work with Peacock](https://corporate.comcast.com/press/releases/comcast-and-fastlys-new-content-delivery-model-powers-highest-quality-experience-for-peacocks-biggest-live-events) to deliver major live sporting events more efficiently, extending the same approach to gaming and other high-demand digital experiences.


### **Less Lag, More Responsive Gameplay**


Faster downloads get players into games sooner, but once they’re online, responsiveness becomes just as important. Comcast is leading the industry in the development of Low Latency DOCSIS, an open-standard technology designed to reduce network delays for gaming and other real-time applications. By reducing the time between a player’s actions and the game’s response, the technology helps deliver smoother, more responsive gameplay.


### **Bringing the Best Gaming Experience into the Home**


Comcast is also helping Xfinity customers get the most out of their home connections with fast Internet speeds, advanced WiFi and tools designed to keep gaming devices performing at their best. To help customers download large game files, Xfinity is offering eligible customers a special gigabit speed boost when they preregister for *Grand Theft Auto VI* .


Additionally, Xfinity’s latest WiFi 7 gateway helps deliver fast, reliable connectivity throughout the home, even when multiple people are gaming, streaming and using connected devices at the same time. Features like Boost a Device in the Xfinity app allow eligible customers to prioritize WiFi performance for their gaming consoles.


Learn more about Comcast’s network investments at[https://corporate.comcast.com/our-network](https://corporate.comcast.com/our-network) .
